|strategy=By Shelby Abercrombie<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/chewiesatst.html</ref>

Not an obvious power card, but [[Chewie's AT-ST]] has some features that may appeal to your deck. The deploy: 2 is quite nice when compared to the power: 3 and the forfeit: 5.

Why put [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] inside? Put [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] outside with Wedge as the pilot. Now we're talking power 12 and a battle destiny for 8 force. Quite efficient. Of course, if you fear [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] with a saber,. then let [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] jump in for a while to stay safe from nasty weapons.

The "deployment restriction" is not very restrictive. Since the Empire has so many cool and powerful Tempest Scouts, it is a pretty safe bet to say that most of your opponents will have one or more AT-ST's in their decks. And when you do deploy [[Chewie's AT-ST]], that weakening effect on your opponents' AT-ST's could add up quite nicely.

This is a difficult card to come by in an [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Booster Draft, and with all the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Light Side pilots ([[Chewbacca]] of [[Kashyyyk]], [[Daughter Of Skywalker]], [[General Solo]]) being rare, even more difficult to use effectively. But don't neglect the fact that it's game text works even without a pilot - thus at your opponents [[Tempest Scout]] stronghold it will still apply its power modifier and its five forfeit, although make sure thatÕs where you want it, because you won't be able to move it!

Combos: Power 12 as well as a battle destiny... for the bargain price of 8 force.

That's right, put good ole Boshek in [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]]'s Chicken Walker and you can go toe-to-toe with up to three Tempest Scouts(now only power two each) AND you get a battle destiny.

Soften your your Opponent's AT-ST's up with Chewies AT-ST, then smack those weakened combat vehicles with a nasty surprise.
